title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Zoom
providers.scope_notes: Distinguish marketplace build-flow settings from account-admin controls for Server-to-Server apps.

controls.name: App pre-approval (Marketplace admin)
controls.what: Requires a Marketplace admin to pre-approve an app before users can authorize it; users can request approval.
controls.setting: Zoom App Marketplace > Manage > Permissions (admin dashboard)
controls.quote: A Zoom account may require an app be pre-approved by a Marketplace admin before the end user may authorize it.

controls.name: Role permissions for admin-level scopes
controls.what: Apps requesting admin scopes can only be authorized by users whose role holds the matching account-level permissions.
controls.quote: Account-level apps (apps with admin) scopes must be authorized by a user with the corresponding account-level permissions.

controls.name: IP allowlist for Marketplace apps
controls.what: Admins approve or reject the IPs an app declares and can enforce the allowlist, blocking token exchange, revocation and API calls from other IPs; S2S app IPs are declared by the admin.
controls.setting: Zoom admin portal: App IP allowlist configuration
controls.quote: account administrators who install your app can: Review the IP addresses your app uses. Approve or reject specific IP addresses. Enable IP allowlist enforcement to restrict API access to approved addresses only.

controls_unknown: Official Zoom support articles for pre-approval (KB0062300) and admin IP allowlist (KB0088682) render only via JavaScript and could not be read; UI paths and defaults are taken from developer docs.
Plan requirements for the Marketplace app IP allowlist.
Whether admins can revoke individual users' OAuth grants for a Marketplace app without removing the app.

authentication.summary: Delegated OAuth bearer; Server-to-Server OAuth using account ID, client ID and client secret.

federation.details: Server-to-Server OAuth supports unattended account-level access but uses an app secret; no general external identity exchange established.

ip_restriction.boundary: Account-admin IP enforcement covers API calls and OAuth endpoints. Server-to-Server restrictions are administered centrally.

renewal.summary: Exchange the refresh token for a new access token and keep the newest refresh token returned. Refresh tokens expire after 90 days; the docs do not say whether refreshing resets that window. After expiry the user must re-authorize.

administration.summary: Granular app scopes, role-controlled app management, activation/deactivation and IP allowlisting.
administration.conditions: Distinguish marketplace build-flow settings from account-admin controls for Server-to-Server apps.

offboard.details: Refreshing fails with error 4735 once the token's user has been removed from the account; docs don't cover deactivation or the up-to-1-hour access token.

inventory.details: Marketplace Manage > Apps on Account dashboard lists all apps on the account (Added apps tab).

network.ui: Zoom Marketplace > Marketplace admin > Marketplace Management > Permissions > Security permissions > IP allow list for apps (Apps tab > Has IPs > app > Add)

expiry.api: POST https://zoom.us/oauth/token response expires_in (3600); refresh token lasts 90 days. Fixed, not configurable

offboard.ui: Zoom web portal > User Management > Users > ... > Deactivate or Delete
offboard.api: PUT /v2/users/{userId}/status (action deactivate); DELETE /v2/users/{userId} (action delete or disassociate); app can also POST https://zoom.us/oauth/revoke

token_format.notes: Docs show access/refresh tokens only as "<JWT_TOKEN>" placeholders, token_type bearer; no documented prefix. Not in GitHub secret-scanning supported patterns list (checked 2026-10-12).

log_sources.name: Marketplace API call logs (GET /marketplace/apps/{appId}/api_call_logs)
log_sources.notes: Per-app log of API calls: url_pattern, method, http_status, time, trace_id. duration 7/14/30 days max. No caller IP or user field documented. Admin dashboard (Manage > Apps on Account) shows the same per-app call usage and CSV export.

log_sources.name: Operation Logs report (GET /report/operationlogs)
log_sources.notes: Admin/user activity (add user, settings change, delete recording). Fields: action, category_type, operation_detail, operator, time. No app/client id or IP documented. Pro+; one month per request.

log_sources.name: app_deauthorized webhook event
log_sources.notes: Sent to the app's endpoint when a user deauthorizes/removes the app; carries account_id, user_id, client_id, deauthorization_time. Only visible to the app owner's webhook receiver.

log_sources.name: Sign in / sign out activity report (GET /report/activities)
log_sources.notes: User interactive sign-ins with ip_address, client_type, version; useful to compare the authorizing user's normal IPs. Range within last six months; Pro+.

credential_id_fields.notes: OAuth app whose grant was removed
Scopes call log to one app; individual tokens are not identified
User who performed the change (email); the app/token is not identified

lifecycle_events.notes: Webhook when a user deauthorizes or removes a production app

anomaly_cues: Spike in calls or new url_pattern values (e.g. /users, /recordings, report endpoints) in the app's api_call_logs
Bursts of 401/403 http_status for the app after a refresh token was rotated or revoked (stale stolen token)
Operation Logs entries (recording deletes, user/settings changes) by the authorizing user at times they were not signed in per /report/activities
API calls continuing for an app after the user who authorized it was deactivated
app_deauthorized followed by renewed calls for the same appId

containment.steps: POST https://zoom.us/oauth/revoke with token=<access_token>; admin Manage > Apps on Account > Added Apps > Disable App or Remove (account-wide) or Disable per user; rotate client secret via POST /marketplace/apps/{appId}/rotate_client_secret with revoke_old_secret_time=now.
containment.notes: Docs do not say whether revoking an access token also kills the refresh token, or whether admin Disable/Remove revokes issued tokens. Access tokens expire after one hour; refresh tokens after 90 days.

sample_query.purpose: List failed auth calls for the app over 30 days to spot stolen or revoked tokens being replayed

unknown: caller IP or user agent per API call
which user's token made a given call in api_call_logs
whether revoke/admin disable invalidates refresh tokens or issued access tokens

calls.reveals: Account and user details of the token principal
calls.log_notes: Operation Logs record admin write-actions; API reads not documented as logged.
